name: Inky (Pimoroni)
description: A Pimoroni Inky panel (Impression or pHAT/wHAT) on the Raspberry Pi's SPI and I2C. The board says which model it is, so there is nothing to choose.

properties.name: saturation
properties.title: Inky Palette Saturation
properties.description: How saturated the colors of a 7-color Inky Impression are drawn: its palette is blended with this much of the pure colors. 0.5 suits most panels. Other Inky boards ignore it.
